description: This file implements password hashing functions and management for the Mattermost server, including handling multiple hashers, migration, and validation logic.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: Interface defining methods for password hashing, comparison, and validation according to the PHC string format.

methods.name: getOriginalHasher
methods.description: Returns the initial bcrypt hasher used in the codebase, which is not PHC-compliant.

methods.name: GetHasherFromPHCString
methods.description: Determines the hasher used for a given PHC string, defaulting to bcrypt if invalid or unknown.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Hashes a password using the latest configured hasher.

methods.name: CompareHashAndPassword
methods.description: Compares a PHC hash with a password using the latest hasher.

methods.name: IsLatestHasher
methods.description: Checks if a given hasher is the current latest hasher.
